note: Read 2026-11-01 at the owner's word ("Build those first 3 starting with ledger first"; of the 21 countries read first: "It should cover across every country"; "Retry the blocked tax facts once all countries land"): the tax on a screen worker's pay in El Salvador: a resident's income tax, social contributions, what is withheld at source, a non-resident artiste's withholding, an author's treatment, VAT and the tax year. figures.finding: A domiciled individual's net income is exempt to USD 6,600 a year, then taxed at USD 212.12 plus 10% over USD 6,600 to USD 10,742.86, USD 720 plus 20% over 10,742.86 to 24,457.14, and USD 3,462.86 plus 30% above (the December recalculation table of Decreto Ejecutivo No. 10, from May 2025); a non-domiciled individual pays 30%. (PwC's table, printing the 10% band over USD 4,064 to 9,142.86, was the law's before D.L. 293 moved its first two tramos.)
figures.applies: From May 2025, read 2026-11-03 in the decree's annual table; no 2026 decree replacing it was found. The table's fixed sum at the start of the 10% band is not one the engine's scales can apply, so the resident's tax is told as not known.

sources.said: Net income (USD) Tax rates Over Not over 0.00 6,600.00 Exempt 6,600 .0 0 9,142.86 USD 212.12 plus 10% on the excess over USD 4,064.00 9,142.86 22,857.14 USD 720.00 plus 20% on the excess over USD 9,142.86 22,857.14 and over USD 3,462.86 plus 30% on the excess over USD 22,857.14 Non-domiciled individuals shall compute their income taxes at 30%.

figures.finding: Employers withhold monthly from May 2025: nothing to USD 550, then USD 17.67 plus 10% over USD 550 to USD 895.24, USD 60 plus 20% over 895.24 to 2,038.10, and USD 288.57 plus 30% above (Decreto Ejecutivo No. 10); a resident individual's fees for services outside employment bear 10% withholding.
figures.applies: From May 2025 (the Ministerio de Hacienda's notice and the decree, read 2026-11-03); PwC's table printed the 10% band's excess over USD 472.

sources.said: Income (USD) Withholding rates Over Not over 0.00 550.00 N/A 550.00 895.24 USD 17.67 plus 10% on the excess over USD 472.00 895.24 2,038.10 USD 60.00 plus 20% on the excess over USD 895.24 2,038.10 and over USD 288.57 plus 30% on the excess over USD 2,038.10
Payments to resident individuals with respect to services rendered, other than under a labour relationship, are subject to a 10% WHT.
Los cambios tendrán efecto a partir del mes de mayo de 2025.

figures.finding: Payments to a non-resident for income earned in El Salvador, including services rendered or used there, bear 20% withholding (25% to a tax haven); payments for rights in films and music records bear a reduced 5%.

sources.said: Payments or amounts credited to non-residents arising from income obtained in El Salvador are subject to a 20% WHT.
Payments for transfer of intangible assets or use of the rights to intangibles and tangible assets related to films, movies, music records, cable TV, satellite, etc.

figures.finding: The fiscal year is the calendar year; the annual return is filed within four months and the tax paid by 30 April.

sources.said: The fiscal year runs from 1 January to 31 December.
Income taxes are due no later than 30 April of each year.

figures.finding: ISSS health insurance takes 3% from the employee and 7.5% from the employer on monthly salary up to USD 1,000 (capped at USD 30 and USD 75); the AFP pension takes 7.25% from the employee and 8.75% from the employer on total salary.

figures.applies: 2026; the registration threshold for a small freelancer was not found in the pages read.

sources.said: VAT (i.e. Impuesto al Valor Agregado or IVA) is levied at a rate of 13% over the taxable amount.
